description: Keyword search over Development Radio's field guides: sourced, answer-first articles that each settle one engineering decision for Senior and Staff engineers, such as a caching pattern or a database schema change. Matches titles, topics, answers and the full text. Up to six keywords of three or more characters are used; a keyword matches at the start of a word. Each result comes with its slug, title, publication date, page URL, one-line description, topics and the best-matching passage. Use this when you need a reasoned engineering recommendation with worked numbers, real incidents from published postmortems and primary sources, then call get_guide with the slug for the full guide. Each guide is written with AI and checked against the primary sources it cites before publication.

limit.description: Maximum number of guides to return.

query.description: Keywords, for example "cache stampede" or "schema migration lock".

name: search_guides
title: Search Development Radio field guides
